areas: 124 upstream commits / 321 files, from bc647ed53595888efacdd8ca435967d48888a952 to 40526f96f6ae3dfe74ae60ca279e748d7838a691. Additive fixes: Git/PR refresh and host opt-ins, tree/diff/editor interaction, provider installs and status, SSH/Tailscale/desktop lifecycle, browser/HTML handling.

Overlaps: managed delegation, Stop/resume, provider starts/usage/background work, stream identity/coalescing, linked-environment senders, No project/SlipJay controls, shared provider settings and fork process ownership. Each affected seam is disposed below; no upstream design is restyled.

Structural: upstream command-read migration 83 becomes fork 124; optional linkedSender/cursorStoreCwd/source-host settings remain additive; upstream session and read-path changes preserve fork callers and shipped-client decoding. Dependency audit compares 913 settings in 47 files; retain fork newer versions and rebase updater patch to 6.8.11.

All 78 record entries and their retirement conditions considered. No complete entry has an exit condition newly satisfied by this tag; the duplicate fork Claude text coalescer is superseded by upstream with a small empty-block-ID extension. No unresolved owner decision.
